title: Raft lecture (Raft user study)
summary: John Ousterhout lectures on the Raft consensus algorithm, made for the Raft user study comparing how students learn Raft and Paxos. It covers leader election and log repair.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a clearer introduction to Raft than the paper and as part of a well-designed understandability study.

quote.text: The 2 videos do an excellent job of explaining both the Paxos and Raft algorithms and the key differences between them.
